capabilities: Adds a tabbed ribbon of command buttons above the workspace
Customises tabs, groups and buttons in place
Exports and imports the layout as a JSON file
Searches and inserts symbols from a palette of over 200 characters
Hosts Markdown Spreadsheets' toolbar as five tabs
disambiguation: Not a restyling of Obsidian's own ribbon; it adds a separate Office-style bar above the workspace.
extras: Desktop only; not in the community catalogue yet, so it is installed with BRAT or by copying release files. No network access or telemetry.
intentEvidence: Inspired by OneNote Style, but deliberately smaller
motivation: Inspired by OneNote Style, but deliberately smaller — Markdown formatting only, no OneNote tags, page colours, subpages or AI integrations.
problem: Obsidian's own ribbon and command palette give no labelled, grouped, always-visible place to keep frequently used commands.

relations.evidence: Inspired by OneNote Style, but deliberately smaller
Its whole Excel-style toolbar as five tabs — Home, Data, Calculate, Table, Export
Create/edit a task and toggle it done, next to Obsidian's own checkbox command.
Insert a Templater template, or start a new note from one.
New drawing, embed a drawing, open one, toggle drawing/text.
New base, insert a base, add a view or an item.
A dedicated Git tab: commit and sync, pull, push, commit all, source control, history and fetch.

summary: Office-style ribbon above the Obsidian workspace with customisable tabs, groups and command buttons in two heights.
